definition: Open an installed plugin and turn its skills, connectors, agents, slash commands, or hooks on or off.
outcome: the chosen components of an already-installed plugin are switched on or off, changing what the plugin contributes to Claude

records.outcome: individual components of an installed plugin are enabled or disabled
steps: Review its skills, connectors, agents, and hooks
Enable or disable individual components as needed

evidence.quote: Open the installed plugin to see its skills, connectors, agents, and hooks. Enable or disable individual components as needed.

records.notes: mode: cowork; Written as the third step of the install sequence, but its outcome is component configuration, not installation. Skills and agents appear as tabs; connectors and hooks have their own pages.

records.outcome: the chosen components of an installed plugin are switched on or off, changing what the plugin contributes
steps: Review the skills, slash commands, sub-agents, and hooks it provides
Turn individual components on or off

evidence.quote: Open an installed plugin to see the skills, slash commands, sub-agents, and hooks it provides, and turn individual components on or off.

records.notes: Connectors declared by a self-added plugin are not added, and a local MCP server it declares never runs.
